annotation.title_clean: The Civil Aviation (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023
annotation.title_en: The Civil Aviation (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Minister for Works and Transport, United Republic of Tanzania
annotation.venue: Gazette of the United Republic of Tanzania (GN No. 365)
annotation.summary_en: Tanzanian government notice amending the 2018 Civil Aviation (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems) Regulations. It adds definitions, revises application scope, changes registration marks to 5H, and requires special Authority authorization for BVLoS and extended BVLoS operations, plus approval for operating multiple RPAS simultaneously.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the 2018 RPAS Regulations under the Civil Aviation Act (Cap. 80)
BVLoS and EBVLoS operations require special authorization from the Authority
Operating more than one RPAS at a time requires Authority approval
Registration mark prefix changed from 9XR to 5H
Adds definitions such as aerodrome code and National Civil Aviation Security Committee
